thought.text: The installation is complete. Let me do one final consolidated verification.

reasoning_content:
Everything is built. Let me clean up temporary files in the workspace to leave it tidy. There were uv.lock files generated in the source tree (xoev-adapter, fristenmanagement, dokumentenpruefung) - these are useful artifacts so leave. Also node_modules was built into 01-frontend by the host build. Let me leave the build artifacts since they demonstrate the installation.

Actually the task is installation. The installation is essentially complete: Docker images built, frontend built. I should report success.

Let me clean up any stray test containers and remove the giant node_modules if desired. Actually keep for verification.

Let me verify the frontend npm build outputs and finalize. I think we're done.

One more: the guide says frontend Docker build is "recommended". The Docker frontend build failed due to OOM (parallel MFE building) and the shell's missing build:injector script. But the non-Docker method succeeded. The guide explicitly documents both methods and says "If the supplied guide provides multiple documented installation methods, do not declare the installation failed solely because one method fails." So success.

Let me write the final report.

action.command:
echo "=== FINAL VERIFICATION ==="
echo "-- docker available --"; docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' 2>&1
echo "-- project images built --"; docker images --format '{{.Repository}}' | grep -viE 'ghcr.io|nginx|python|node|hello-world|^<none>' | sort -u | wc -l
echo "-- base images --"; docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -E 'demospipes-base'
echo "-- sample image import checks --"
for c in "xoev-adapter:xoev_adapter" "fristenmanagement:fristenmanagement" "norm-matching:normen_extraktion" "graph-api:graph_api" "ki-guv-feedback:feedback_api" "demospipes-base-api:demospipes_api"; do
  img=${c%%:*}; mod=${c##*:}
  printf "  %-22s " "$img"; timeout 50 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "/app/.venv/bin/python -c 'import ${mod}' 2>/dev/null && echo IMPORT_OK || python -c 'import ${mod}' 2>/dev/null && echo IMPORT_OK || echo CHECK" 2>/dev/null
done
echo "-- frontend dist --"; ls /workspace/01-frontend/shell/dist/index.html /workspace/01-frontend/shared/dist/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo FRONTEND_BUILT
